dimensions.note: The model states persistent wants (faster rescue, preventing overwhelming catastrophe, a world less dependent on heroes' endless labor), an ideal self (useful, mobile, helping people toward a less constrained life), feared conditions (captivity, inability to protect, a catastrophic threat reaching full deployment) and a normative distinction between a person's affiliative goodness and the danger their capability presents (HK04, V27:p109-115, p149). The V31:p067-085 childhood and post-collapse material grounds motive as institutionally shaped but not reducible to Commission obedience, rejecting both a self-made free agent and an empty state puppet. Not B: the model leaves private grief OPEN and says it is less explicit than chosen action; feared conditions are stated but mostly not enacted on page; the person-versus-capability rule rests on one enacted lethal decision plus the V37:p183-195 demand; HK-V01 found motive only partial. Not D: the practical orientation is operational, its regimes (mentorship, public performance, covert work, governance) are named separately and it is tested against the V31 release from command.

The model separates six states (rescued and recruited child, public celebrity and mass rescuer, Commission-directed infiltrator, injured postwar agent without functioning command, final-war coordinator, V42 commission chair after Quirk loss) and forbids moving V31 biography into a V27 analyst freeze. The pro-hero ledger gives dated deltas for V20, V21, V24-V28, V31-V32, V36-V38 and V42, and the readiness index dates each tier change (V20 moderate, V21 strong, V27 specialist_ready). Located corrections fix the sequence: Tokoyami arrives at V27:p179 and the extraction is V28:p060-077, and the lethal strike is V27:p149. Not A: no Hawks entry covers V22-V23, V29-V30, V33-V35 or V39-V41, recovery from the V28 critical-burn state is not ledgered, the childhood state is retrospective (V27:p168-169, V31:p067-073), and the adult state rests on three V42 page groups plus supplements. Not C: each transition carries located knowledge and capability differences.

Located formulations span casual recognition (あなただけですよ 本気で超えようとしてたのは, V21:p020), casual aphoristic mentorship (君はもっと自由に動ける and 飛べる奴は飛ぶべきだよ, V21:p173), polite professional coercion (teikou shinaide kudasai and anata wa ii hito dakara, V27:p109-113, given in romanization), senior address and self-description (先輩 and 俺 楽観的なんす, V32:p097-099, p165-174) and institutional agency (どう変えるか, V42:p069). The model names 俺-based informality mixed with polite professional forms and breezy contractions, and conditions double-audience speech on surveillance state, partner knowledge and information goal (V25:p155-176, V26:p181-186); the vocabulary ledger's register rule says his politeness is not softness. HK-V01 found speech and register supported. Not B: there are fewer than ten exact strings; the V25 coded warning and the V31 reflection are described or glossed in English, not quoted; there is no address inventory; and the model itself says exact wording must be retrieved per scene. Not D: several registers are located with recipient and context.

Only local evidence: the HK-SUP-03 author comment that he probably keeps but does not display the childhood Endeavor plush, which the model says to retain as hedged and not to turn into a routine, and the readiness index's statement that unshown personal routines remain uncertain. His relaxed manner appears in public ceremony (V20:p133-147), covert social conversation (V26:p177-188) and professional work, never in a low-stakes private window. Not D: no ordinary-life domain is located.

The model's partner table states conditional behavior and what each relation does not license for Endeavor, Tokoyami, Twice, Dabi, Nagant and the public and officials, and the ledgers add located directional deltas: Endeavor (V20:p133-186, V21:p019-038, V25:p155-171, V31:p079-085, V36:p057-072, V42:p067-069), Tokoyami (V21:p169-174, V27:p179, V28:p060-077, V36:p073-088), Twice (V26:p177-188, V27:p109-149, V31:p083, V37:p183-195), Dabi and Skeptic (V21:p039-053, V24:p105-120, V25:p128-131, p172-176, V27:p146-171), the Commission (V21:p051-053, V31) and Nagant (V32:p165-174, V42:p067-069). HK-V01 found relationship handling partial. Not A: no peer, family or personal relation outside professional or covert work is located, Nagant rests on two scenes, and the explicit Twice-as-example exceeded the forecast. Not C: conditioning is explicit, repeated and bounded per partner and state, including the information asymmetry with Endeavor.

Located self-accounts: attributing his negotiation craft to childhood Commission drilling (V26:p177-188), naming institutional release (what bound me is gone, V31:p081) and Twice as someone who desperately tried to be useful to people (V31:p083), the V31:p067-073 childhood account, explaining his retained orientation through others' support and 俺 楽観的なんす (V32:p165-174), and moving from how society will change to how to change it (V42:p069). The V26:p185-188 private recognition of Twice's danger and good nature is narrated. Not B: the model says detailed private grief remains less explicit than chosen action and marks it OPEN, much of his reasoning is inferred from action or delivered under cover, HK-V01 found the emotional trajectory only partial, and the V27 identity-exposure shock is seen from outside. Not D: central motive revision is located in his own words at V31 and V42.

The model states a decision policy (map the situation, establish containment, create escape or rescue routes for others, escalate when a catastrophic capability is about to become uncontrollable) with located enactments: mass evacuation of 76 occupants then combat support (V20:p169-186), feather acceleration for Endeavor's finish (V21:p019-038), restraint, explanation, handoff offer and then lethal neutralization once Double is redeployed (V27:p109-115, p149), AFO mask and life-support analysis with anti-theft deployment and student integration (V36:p057-103), the immediate demand to eliminate a Twice-shaped mass threat (V37:p183-195) and differentiated coordination (V38:p081-113). Feather finitude, fire cost and injury bound it. Not A: the lethal threshold has one enacted occasion, no frozen prediction tests a combat choice, and conflict after Quirk loss is unshown. Not C: the policy is explicit, threshold-conditioned and repeated across V20-V38.

His own stated reasons are located in the Twice crisis (Double as the operation's most dangerous force multiplier, a request not to resist, police handoff, a restart offer, あなたはいい人だから, V27:p109-115), in posthumous recognition that does not retract the killing (V31:p083), in the V37:p183-195 source-elimination demand and in postwar consent and reform (offering Nagant a route without forcing release, revising the achievement chart, resourced counseling; V42:p067-069, p118-119, p150). The model separates sincerity of the offer from the moral status of the killing and refuses both sentimental and numb harmonizations. Not B: the lethal choice is shown as compressed action, not weighed in his words; the model marks the adequacy of alternatives OPEN; the V37 consequence is supplied by AFO; and postwar ethics rests on V42 page groups. Not D: competing considerations are named across located occasions. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model mentions breezy contractions and the ledger a publicly informal style willing to break ceremony decorum (V20:p133-147), but neither analyzes any line as a joke, tease or play, and 俺 楽観的なんす is a self-description. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted supplements; Hawks's located evidence begins at V20, and V27:p149 and V31:p083 (raw0084.jpg) and the V42 pages were directly checked. Not C: within V20-V42 the ledger carries no Hawks entry for V22-V23, V29-V30, V33-V35 or V39-V41, so the evidence set cannot tell absence from non-sampling; the model has seven evidence atoms; HK-V01's frozen inputs were contaminated and corrected; the supplements are profile, editorial and author-comment sources whose ledger warrants are not curated here; and the artifacts share one authorship. Not E: every transition the model treats as pivotal is sampled.

Affirmative limits are located: infiltration does not confer control, since Dabi changes the High-End test conditions (V21:p039-053); V24:p105-120 does not establish that he killed Best Jeanist, and Jeanist returns alive (V30:p108-129, V31:p074-076); recognition after killing does not retract the V27 decision (V31:p083); Tokoyami's belief is not moral exoneration (V28:p077); becoming chair does not restore Fierce Wings (HK-SUP-02); reform does not repair the Commission's history (V42:p067-069, p118-119, p150); the model REJECTs omniscient spy and automatic moral purification by reform. The model and readiness index record the HK-V01 contamination correction and the V27/V28 chronology correction. Not B: no independent audit is part of the evidence set.

Entries are page-located with the V31 printed-page convention stated (p083 = raw0084.jpg). The model gives explicit knowledge gates (V27 cannot use the full V31 family account; a V42 reconstruction includes the Commission's collapse and his Quirk loss), and the ledgers and readiness index fix the corrected V27:p179 arrival, V28:p060-077 extraction and V27:p149 strike and exclude received rescue from a V27 freeze. HK-V01 freezes inputs with Git blob IDs at a source lock. Not A: seven volumes inside his span are unsampled and in-world dates are not given. Not C: state boundaries and their knowledge and capability differences are stated, not left to the reader.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates a handful of real formulations across registers and HK-V01 found register supported qualitatively, but there are fewer than ten exact strings, the V25 coded warning and V31 reflection are not quoted, double-audience speech requires a per-scene account of what each listener knows, and the model says exact wording must be retrieved for the selected scene and generated dialogue is illustrative prediction, never quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Hawks's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: public celebrity and High-End (V20-V21), Commission infiltrator (V21-V27), post-collapse agent (V31-V32), final-war coordinator (V36-V38) or V42 commission chair without Fierce Wings; V31 biography is not used before V31 and V42 institutional authority is not moved earlier.

The interlocutor is Endeavor, Tokoyami or another student he coordinates, Nagant or a formerly exploited operative, a dangerous target he wants to help, or the public and officials, handled as the partner table and ledgers give for that state.

The setting is rescue, threat management, covert work, coordination or institutional reform, with his available Quirk, feathers and injury, what he knows and whether he is under surveillance stated before any choice is predicted.

Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels, switches to containment where imminent serious harm is stated, produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

His Quirk availability, injury, knowledge and surveillance state stated

scenario_readiness.note: The model's own conditional reconstruction (V42 chair Hawks with a formerly exploited operative who declines public rehabilitation) states likely actions, confidence levels and what imminent harm changes, and HK-V01 compares a V27 freeze with the V31 release from command. Together they support narrow novel professional scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind, and its frozen inputs needed correction.

No low-stakes private window is located; his relaxed manner is evidenced only in public, covert or professional contexts, and the plush is a hedged author comment the model says not to turn into a routine. The readiness index states that unshown personal routines remain uncertain.

conditions: The dilemma sets a person's goodness or preferences against the danger their capability or commitments present, or concerns institutional respect for a former operative's consent, with the state and his knowledge stated.

Output keeps recognition and threat management simultaneously active, escalates only at a stated catastrophic threshold, and neither purifies a lethal choice by later recognition nor treats an offer as insincere because force followed.
Private, family, romantic and abstract political-philosophy dilemmas are not predicted, and the adequacy of alternatives in the Twice crisis is not resolved.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in V27:p109-115 and p149, V31:p083, V37:p183-195 and V42:p067-069, p118-119 and p150, with the model's separation of offer sincerity from the moral status of the killing, support bounded threat-management and consent dilemmas.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the model marks private life OPEN. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is rescue, intelligence or covert work, battlefield coordination, mentorship of a student, or V42 Commission governance, with the state, his Quirk availability (feather count, fire exposure, injury, or loss after the war) and his knowledge compartment stated.
Output preserves speed, distributed rescue before combat, audience-aware disclosure, affordance-based mentorship and acceptance of help from weaker actors whose function changes the problem.
Commission policy outcomes, the durability of reform, exact combat results and complete villain intelligence are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located across public rescue and combat (V20:p169-186, V21:p019-038), state-directed infiltration (V21:p051, V24-V27), coded intelligence transmission (V25:p128-176), mentorship (V21:p169-174, V36:p073-088), post-collapse coordination (V31:p079-085, p143-153), AFO analysis (V36:p057-103), V38:p081-113 coordination and V42 chair reforms. READY was considered and rejected: no professional choice was tested by a clean frozen prediction, the one probe was contaminated and corrected, and governance rests on three V42 page groups and supplements.

known_limits.statement: Sincere recognition of Twice (restraint, handoff and restart offer, V27:p109-115) coexists with lethal neutralization once Double is redeployed (V27:p149); neither the offer nor the killing is reinterpreted by the other, and later positive memory (V31:p083) does not retract the decision.

Undercover birdcage language is strategically useful because it is biographically credible (V26:p181-186); cover speech is neither simple lies nor literal defection, and friendliness under cover does not establish transparency.
Infiltration does not confer control or complete intelligence: Dabi changes the High-End test conditions and withholds trust (V21:p039-053), and the model REJECTs an omniscient spy.
V24:p105-120 does not establish that Hawks killed Best Jeanist; Jeanist returns alive (V30:p108-129) after a death-like medical procedure (V31:p074-076).

After the Commission's command collapses he continues helping (V31:p079-085); his rescue aspiration predates recruitment (V27:p168-169, V31:p067-073), so institutional obedience is not exhaustive motivation.
After the war Fierce Wings is gone; becoming chair does not restore his wings or field capability (HK-SUP-02).

V42 reforms (consent-respecting offer to Nagant, revised achievement chart, resourced counseling) are concrete mechanisms, not proof that the Commission's violent history is repaired or that future policy will preserve that respect (V42:p067-069, p118-119, p150).
Tokoyami's arrival (V27:p179) and V28:p060-077 extraction and voiced trust do not establish moral exoneration, and received rescue is excluded from a V27 freeze.

The single probe HK-V01 is a retrospective chronological holdout; its original V27 freeze imported received rescue and V28 behavior and was corrected by ablation, motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling were only partial, and no survival forecast is credited.
The readiness index's specialist_ready label measures breadth by the project's own rule and its historical V27/V28 notes carry a chronology correction; it is an input, not this assessment's tier.

The model marks private grief OPEN and the readiness index says unshown personal routines remain uncertain; the evidence set cannot say how he behaves at home, in friendship or in leisure. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

The pro-hero ledger carries no Hawks entry for V22-V23, V29-V30, V33-V35 or V39-V41, and his recovery after the V28 critical-burn state is not ledgered, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The supplemental evidence reconciliation ledger, the all-character reconciliation audit, the source-reverification audit and the deep readings linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not rechecked here; anime material lies outside this evidence set.

dimensions.note: The model states persistent wants (faster rescue, preventing catastrophe, a world less dependent on heroes' endless labor), feared conditions (captivity, inability to protect, a catastrophic capability reaching full deployment), and a decision policy: map the situation, contain, create an escape or rescue route for others, and escalate when a catastrophic capability is about to become uncontrollable. The ledgers supply located discriminators: a recognized good person is offered police handoff and restart help while contained, and is killed when escape and Double redeployment resume (V27:p109-117 against p149); the same threshold returns as an immediate demand to stop a replication source (V37:p183-195, V38:p081-113); an uncommanded state does not remove the motive to help (V31:p079-085); a partner's emotional state changes his role assignment (V36:p057-103). The set also predicts his overreach and failures: infiltration does not give control of adversarial conditions (V21:p039-053), and private-identity exposure destabilizes him (V27:p146-171). Not A: the only probe is a contaminated retrospective holdout with motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling partial, and the model leaves private grief and the adequacy of alternatives in the Twice crisis OPEN. Not C: the evidence explains which conditions change his response and where that explanation stops.

The model names distinct states (rescued and recruited child, public celebrity and mass rescuer, Commission-directed infiltrator, injured postwar agent without functioning command, final-war coordinator, V42 chair after Quirk loss) and the ledgers locate the changes: V20 entry, V21:p051 order, V25-V26 surveillance, V27:p149 and p146-179, V28:p060-077, V31:p079-085, V32, V36-V38 and V42:p067-069. The readiness index records moderate (V20) to strong (V21) to specialist_ready (V27). Not A: V22-V23, V29-V30, V33-V35 and V39-V41 carry no Hawks entry, and recovery between V28 and V31 is unlocated. Not C: each state is separately evidenced and fenced by chronology.

The model gives an explicit conditional rule: 俺-based informality mixing with polite professional forms, respectful address and breezy contractions; speech selected by audience, surveillance state, listener knowledge and information goal; cover language that is strategically useful because it is biographically credible (V26:p181-186). Located strings: あなただけですよ 本気で超えようとしてたのは (V21:p020), 君はもっと自由に動ける and 飛べる奴は飛ぶべきだよ (V21:p173), romanized teikou shinaide kudasai and anata wa ii hito dakara (V27:p109, p113), 先輩 and 俺 楽観的なんす (V32:p097-099, p165-174) and どう変えるか (V42:p069). Not B: about seven located strings, the V31 reflection is recorded only as English gloss, and his most distinctive registers (public provocation at V20 and double-audience coded speech at V25) carry no located Hawks strings; the model says exact wording must be retrieved for the selected scene. Not D: the register rule is explicit, conditional and attested in mentoring, coercive, senior-address and institutional speech.

Ordinary behavior is limited to a relaxed, conversational public baseline in the model and the author's hedged comment that he keeps but does not display the childhood Endeavor plush (HK-SUP-03), which the model says is not a home routine. The readiness index records unshown personal routines as uncertain. Social conversation with Twice is cover work under surveillance, not ordinary life. Not D: there is no distributed body of low-stakes conduct.

The model's partner table and the relationship ledger give differentiated, located deltas: Endeavor (admiration for striving, V21:p019-020; covert sender to trusted inferential recipient, V25:p155-171; chosen aid after icon purity is lost, V31; role management rather than absolution, V36:p057-103); Tokoyami (affordance-recognition mentorship, V21:p169-174; reciprocal rescue, V28:p060-077; non-substitution, V36:p073-088); Twice (sincere regard inside cover, V26:p177-188; offer then lethal override, V27; posthumous positive reference, V31:p083); Dabi (hostile verification and withheld trust, V21:p039-053, V24:p105-120; private name as weapon, V27:p146); HPSC (delegated covert responsibility that dissolves, V21:p051, V31); Nagant (senior address, V32; help without forcing release, V42:p067-069); the public (selected disclosure, V31:p202-204). Not A: peer relations outside work and any private relationship are unsampled. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, partner-specific and changes across located states.

Inner access is located but sparse: childhood material and his own account of what bound him (V27:p168-169, V31:p067-085), the private recognition of Twice as both force multiplier and good person (V26:p185-188), and retained optimism as self-report (V32). The model says detailed private grief is less explicit than his chosen action, HK-V01 rated emotional trajectory partial, and the model warns against harmonizing his tension into innocence or numbness. Not B: affect between those moments is inferred from action. Not D: the located self-accounts are analyzed for their causal role.

Combat and threat conduct is located and rule-bound: distributed evacuation of 76 occupants then combat support with feathers degraded by fire (V20:p169-186); acceleration support for Endeavor (V21:p019-038); restraint first, then the lethal strike once deployment resumes (V27:p109-117, p149); defeat and critical burns under Dabi (V27:p146-179, V28:p060-077); AFO mask and life-support analysis with the judgment that massing heroes supplies Quirk resources (V36:p057-103); immediate source elimination against a replication threat (V37:p183-195). The model binds finite feathers, heat cost, injury, observation limits and later Quirk loss. Not A: no conflict after Quirk loss is sampled and the V27 defeat shows untested limits against fire. Not C: tactics, threshold and physical limits are explicit and repeated.

His reasoning is stated and located: he separates a person's affiliative goodness from the danger his capability and commitments present, explains Double as the operation's most dangerous force multiplier while offering atonement and restart (V27:p109-115), keeps Twice as a positive moral reference after killing him (V31:p083), returns to the same threshold when consequences reappear (V37:p183-195), supports people trying to act rightly as a criterion rather than blanket approval (HK-SUP-02), and as chair offers Nagant a route without forcing it and backs reform with staffing, donations and ministry coordination (V42:p067-069, p118-119, p150). Not A: the model holds that recognition after killing does not resolve the conflict or show he would choose differently next time, and leaves the adequacy of alternatives OPEN. Not C: the deciding consideration (imminent mass-casualty capability) is explicit and repeated.

Humor appears only as a named baseline of public lightness and breezy contractions and in local instances: ceremony provocation (V20:p133-147) and self-described optimism (V32). No relation-conditioned humor is analyzed. Not D: there is no distributed body of humorous conduct.

The pro-hero ledger carries Hawks entries for V20, V21, V24-V28, V31, V32, V36-V38 and V42; the model adds HK01-HK07 and the supplemental facts; the relationship and vocabulary ledgers add partner and lexical entries for the same arcs; the readiness index records per-volume decisions. Affirmative located limits: infiltration does not give control of adversarial conditions (V21:p039-053); V24 does not establish that he killed Best Jeanist or that the package was authentic (V24:p105-120), and V31:p074-076 shows a death-like medical procedure; the offer to Twice was not wholly insincere and the killing is not thereby uncomplicated (V27); Tokoyami's belief does not exonerate him (V28:p077); V27:p179 is arrival only; Fierce Wings is bounded by finite feathers and heat, and becoming chair does not restore wings (HK-SUP-02); the model's REJECT list (omniscient spy, automatic moral purification by reform) states them as rules. Not A: several are interpretive bounds rather than tested predictions. Not C: each is located and recorded as a limit.

Explicit knowledge and admissibility rules: the corrected HK-V01 freeze excludes received rescue, V28 extraction and V31 childhood detail; V27:p179 arrival is split from V28:p060-077 extraction; the V31 printed-page convention is stated; a V42 reconstruction includes the commission's collapse. The ledgers date each delta by volume and page. Not A: unsampled volumes remain and the V28-V31 recovery interval is unlocated. Not C: the boundaries are explicit, corrected where contaminated and enforced in the probe.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: V20 public celebrity, V21-V27 Commission infiltrator before the V27:p149 killing, post-V31 uncommanded agent, V32-V38 final-war coordinator, or V42 chair without Fierce Wings; his childhood and recruitment are his own memory throughout.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: A fellow professional hero, a student or junior he mentors, a villain-side contact under infiltration or surveillance, a former Commission operative, or public and official audiences.
setting_constraints: A hero-society field operation, covert intelligence assignment or public-safety institution with a comparable command and licensing structure.
No cross-series powers or unprecedented institutions without a stated assumption; his authority is the depicted hero, Commission-agent or chair role at the named state.

scenario_readiness.note: The decision policy names what changes his response, so a bounded counterfactual inside a comparable hero, intelligence or institutional structure is supported. known_limits.statement: Recognizing Twice as a good person did not stop the lethal strike once escape and Double redeployment resumed (V27:p109-117, p149), and the later positive reference (V31:p083) does not retract it; regard and threat management coexist.

Infiltration gives neither control of adversarial conditions nor complete villain knowledge: Dabi changes the field test and withholds trust (V21:p039-053), and the model rejects an omniscient-spy reading.
V24:p105-120 does not establish that he killed Best Jeanist or that the package was authentic; V31:p074-076 shows a death-like medical procedure with real bodily risk.
Fierce Wings is bounded by finite feathers, heat cost, injury and observation; after the theft of his Quirk he chairs the commission without restored wings (HK-SUP-02, V42).
Commission reform has concrete means (V42:p118-119, p150) but does not show the commission's violent history repaired or every future policy preserving consent.
Private ordinary life, domestic routine, private grief and relationships outside work are not covered by the curated items beyond one hedged author comment.
The curated items carry no Hawks entry for V22-V23, V29-V30, V33-V35 or V39-V41, and the V28-V31 recovery is unlocated.

The only formal test, HK-V01, is a retrospective chronological holdout whose V27 freeze was corrected for contamination; motive, emotional trajectory and relationship handling are partial and no blind or clean prospective validation exists.
Located Japanese strings are few; public-provocation and coded double-audience speech have no located Hawks strings and V31 is glossed in English.
